name: Looka
tagline: Looka is an AI-powered logo maker and brand identity platform that lets anyone create a professional logo in minutes. After generating dozens of options from your name and style inputs, it packages everything into a Brand Kit — logo files in every format, a matching colour palette, fonts, and social media assets. It's a go-to for founders who need a complete brand identity before their launch.
